paragraphs: I am a software engineer with over eight years of experience designing and building distributed systems at scale. My career spans high-growth startups and established technology companies, where I have consistently delivered reliable, high-performance backend services. I specialise in C++, Python, and cloud-native architectures, with a strong bias toward observable, well-tested code.

Google's commitment to engineering excellence and its culture of rigorous technical review are qualities I deeply respect. I am particularly drawn to the scale challenges inherent in Google's infrastructure — building systems that serve billions of users reliably demands the kind of first-principles thinking I find most rewarding.

Over the last three years I led the re-architecture of a mission-critical event-streaming platform, reducing p99 latency from 420ms to 38ms and improving delivery guarantees from at-least-once to exactly-once semantics. I have a track record of shipping complex features on schedule, mentoring junior engineers, and leaving codebases meaningfully better than I found them. I would welcome the chance to bring that same rigour and ownership to your team.
